title: "GRCh38 Native-versus-Cross-Task Chromosome Learning Curves"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  metrics_path: null
  negative_kind: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, dpi=120)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(gt); library(scales)})
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=11) + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),legend.position="bottom"))
task_colors <- c(EVN="#0072B2", SVN="#D55E00")
mode_lines <- c(Native="solid", `Cross-task`="dashed")
```

```{r inputs, include=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$metrics_path) || is.null(params$negative_kind)) stop("metrics_path and negative_kind are required")
metrics_path <- normalizePath(params$metrics_path, mustWork=TRUE)
x <- read.delim(metrics_path, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
if (nrow(x) != 504) stop("Expected 504 rows; found ", nrow(x))
if (!all(x$negative_kind == params$negative_kind)) stop("Negative-kind mismatch")
if (!all(x$split %in% c("train_100","validation","test"))) stop("Invalid split")
x <- x |> mutate(
  Model=recode(model,lsgkm="LS-GKM",alphagenome="AlphaGenome"),
  `Model task`=toupper(model_task), `Evaluation task`=toupper(evaluation_task),
  Mode=factor(recode(evaluation_mode,native="Native",cross="Cross-task"),
              levels=c("Native","Cross-task")),
  Split=factor(recode(split,train_100="Full training pool",validation="Validation",test="Test"),
               levels=c("Full training pool","Validation","Test")),
  ranking_error=1-auroc)
metric_limits <- function(v) {
  span <- diff(range(v,na.rm=TRUE)); pad <- max(span*.08,.002)
  range(v,na.rm=TRUE)+c(-pad,pad)
}
cross_plot <- function(metric,title,label) {
  ggplot(x,aes(n_training_total,.data[[metric]],color=`Evaluation task`,
               linetype=Mode,group=interaction(`Model task`,`Evaluation task`,Mode))) +
    geom_line(linewidth=.85) + geom_point(size=1.8) +
    facet_grid(Split ~ Model,scales="free_x") +
    scale_color_manual(values=task_colors) + scale_linetype_manual(values=mode_lines) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels=comma,expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.03))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=metric_limits(x[[metric]])) +
    labs(title=title,x="Cumulative training observations",y=label,
         color="Evaluation data",linetype="Mode")
}
```

# Scope and interpretation

This report compares native evaluation with transfer to the other regulatory task
for the cumulative chromosome learning curves. EVN-trained models are evaluated on
EVN data natively and SVN data cross-task; SVN-trained models are evaluated in the
opposite direction. All models use `r params$negative_kind` negatives.

Chr1 is validation, chr2 is held-out test, and training checkpoints cumulatively add
chr3 through chrX. The full-training-pool panels evaluate every checkpoint on the
opposite task's complete 100% training pool. They are common-reference curves, not
ordinary in-sample estimates for early checkpoints.

# AUROC learning curves

```{r auroc}
cross_plot("auroc","Native and cross-task AUROC","AUROC")
```

# Average-precision learning curves

```{r auprc}
cross_plot("auprc","Native and cross-task average precision","Average Precision")
```

# AUROC ranking-error curves

```{r ranking}
cross_plot("ranking_error","Native and cross-task AUROC ranking error","1 - AUROC")
```

# Full-training comparison

```{r full}
x |> filter(checkpoint_index==max(checkpoint_index)) |>
  select(Model,`Model task`,`Evaluation task`,Mode,Split,n_training_total,
         n_evaluation_total,auroc,auprc) |>
  rename(`Training observations`=n_training_total,
         `Evaluation observations`=n_evaluation_total,
         AUROC=auroc,`Average Precision`=auprc) |>
  arrange(Model,Split,`Model task`,Mode) |>
  gt(groupname_col="Model") |> tab_header(title="Final chr3-through-chrX models") |>
  fmt_integer(columns=c(`Training observations`,`Evaluation observations`)) |>
  fmt_number(columns=c(AUROC,`Average Precision`),decimals=3)
```

# Reproducibility notes

- Solid lines are native evaluations; dashed lines are cross-task evaluations.
- Color identifies the evaluation dataset, not the model's training task.
- Full training pool, validation, and test are displayed with the same metric ranges.
- The obsolete outer-fold stability analysis is intentionally omitted.
- Test data are used only for final evaluation.
